entries.zh: 凭据；凭准（作为某物凭证的标记）
entries.en: token or warrant for something; a sign serving as proof

entries.zh: 记凭；写下作为凭据（记账为凭）
entries.en: to note down as a voucher; to record in writing as proof
entries.notes: L 栏截断为‘leda-’无法展开，释义主要依据 H‘憑記’与 M‘pīn qui’

entries.zh: 记号；备忘的记号（帮助记忆或表明约定的标志）
entries.en: a mark or sign; mnemonic sign of remembrance or agreement

entries.zh: 记认；辨认用的记号（便于识别的标记）
entries.en: recognition mark; identifying sign
entries.notes: L 栏‘gu conocl-’截断，按 ‘conocimiento’（认记）推断展开；释义以 H‘記認’为主

entries.en: vestige; mark of something old or ancient
entries.notes: H 封存件录作‘灸迹’，据 L ‘cosa antigua’（旧物）与 M ‘cū chiâ’ 判断当为‘旧迹’

entries.zh: 标记；白领巾（基督徒或读书人用以作标记的白带）
entries.en: sign: the white sash or band worn by Christians or literati
white band or sash; idem, same as the preceding
entries.notes: L 栏明示 idem（同前条）；H 第三字‘裎’字形存疑，依 L 栏释义

entries.en: scar; mark of a wound

entries.zh: 疤痕；痕迹（伤口愈合留下的记号）
entries.en: scar; trace or mark left by a wound

entries.zh: 十字圣号；画十字（天主教划十字的标记）
entries.en: the sign of the cross
entries.notes: H 录作‘十二号’，与‘字’同音；据 L ‘Señal dela cruz’（十字圣号）判定实为‘十字号/画十字’

entries.zh: 下定钱；定金（成交时先付的定钱作为标记）
entries.en: down payment; earnest money given as a token of purchase
designated, marked out; chosen, selected
to draw, to mark; to make a sign
to point with the finger
to point out; to guide, direct
to set bounds; to fix a limit
to delimit; to restrict, fix boundaries

entries.zh: 断约；议定（定下约定、划清界限）
entries.en: to settle terms by agreement; to fix a covenant
to appoint a time; to fix the hour
entries.notes: H 栏仅录‘刻’，M 栏‘quec sī’第二音节无对应字；释义据 L ‘Señalar tiempo’（定时）

entries.en: to point out, indicate something; to show
to point at; make a sign at something
